why: The Tyndale Open Bible Dictionary, read by `type: dictionary`.
`dataset` is the id the release is registered under on a machine, with `sp dataset add`; it is
the catalog's own id for the resource. The text served is Tyndale's own release, not the
Aquifer adaptation: ACAI's ids are the adaptation's, so an article is found by its title.
`articles` is where the articles lie inside the release. `language` is the one it is in.
`attribution` is the credit its CC BY-SA 4.0 licence asks for, carried with every answer.
